values.name: audio codec
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll strings ('ultra-wideband (sub-band CELP)', libspeex error texts) + ELQOpenDecoder 0x100045e0 selects the UWB mode table for 32000 Hz

values.name: frame size
values.source: bin header word 5; read as frame stride in LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x10004340

values.name: bit rate
values.source: bin header word 1 (110 bytes x 50 frames/s)

values.name: Speex quality
values.source: bin header word 2 and the '.10.' in the file name

values.name: frames in Roberto
values.source: bin header word 6; equals (file size - 156) / 110 exactly; checked in test roberto_index_ends_where_its_recordings_end

values.name: text header XOR key
values.source: derived: makes 'LOQUENDOTTS7' appear at offset 2 in all four voice files (keys 0x61, 0xb9, 0x09, 0xe4)

values.name: text header length
values.source: derived: (id u16le, len u16le) fields after the magic; id 1 holds the length (Roberto 128, Katrin 125)

values.name: first frame offset
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x10004340: frame k read at k*frame_bytes + 0x1c + base

values.name: frame XOR key
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x10004530 reads header byte 0x1b into +0x11e4; 0x10004290 XORs every frame byte with it when non-zero (Roberto 0xc9)

values.name: decoder delay
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x100045e0 stores 0x1fd at +0x34; ELQDecode 0x10004530 adds it to the start sample

values.name: warm-up frames on seek
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x100045e0 stores 6 at +0x38; 0x10004340 decodes from frame-6

values.name: sde byte shift
values.source: every byte >= 0x80 is the character + 0x80; line feeds are plain (Roberto.sde offset 0x20)

values.name: sde number digits
values.source: derived: makes every sentence start = previous start + its phone lengths + 1000, and the last end = frame count x 640 / 0.32

values.name: sde time unit
values.source: derived: Roberto's last phone ends at 671271794 ticks = 214806974 samples, 706 samples (22 ms) before the end of its 335637 x 640 samples; test roberto_index_ends_where_its_recordings_end

values.name: gap between sentences
values.source: derived from consecutive '!' starts (750 in a few places)

values.name: records per sentence
values.value: one L + one R per phone, edges excluded
values.source: derived: pairs = phones - 2 for all 4329 Roberto and 5298 Katrin sentences

values.name: record fields
values.source: derived; pitch matches pitch measured in the decoded audio (117 Hz stored vs 118.5 measured on Roberto sentence 2)

values.name: word boundary mark
values.source: observed in U= lines: 'o-i' in 's `o n o-i n a v: ...' (sono inavvertitamente)

values.name: sentence type line
values.source: observed: Roberto has 118 S=I and 5 S=E (e.g. after "a tt: `E n Ts j `o n e" = attenzione!), Katrin 34 / 16

values.source: original engine default ShortPauseLength; its transcription events show #50

values.source: original engine default MediumPauseLength (loquendo-tts-server parameter table)

values.source: original engine default LongPauseLength; its events show @500

values.source: learned from the original engine's ttsPhoneticTranscription of 87421 Hunspell words (src/it-position.tsv)

values.name: sentence words identical to the original
original unit
values.source: LoqTTS7 unit-selection event 19: sentence id at +4, half-phone count at +0x18

values.name: original time/pitch change
values.source: event 3 phone durations equal the recorded ones within 1 ms (benchmark sentence 0)

values.name: play offset
values.source: measured: with it pieces match the original's audio at 70-80 dB, without it they don't

values.name: join style (original)
values.source: measured: joins rebuilt without any fade match at 79 and 49 dB

values.name: excitation handed to the 8-16 kHz band
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll decoder ctl 0x1000f0e0 case 0x66, constant at 0x10022e58; folding sign -1.0 at 0x100242f8

values.name: decoder high-pass
values.source: older Speex in LTTS7Codec210 has none; measured below 250 Hz: 10 dB with it, 40 dB without

values.name: exact join rule
values.value: not known (cuts move by a few to a few dozen samples)

values.name: unit decode margin
values.value: 64 samples at 32 kHz ((rate/10*400)/20000; x4 for PSOLA units)

values.name: max half-phones per phrase
values.source: LoqTTS7.dll 0x100472f0 'Too many demiphones in this phrase'

values.name: main program
values.source: Raffaele - Italian.exe string 0x40b188 used from entry

values.name: picker
values.value: greedy, left to right, jump ahead by the count picked

values.name: question unit factor
values.value: x1.5 if a question is wanted, else /3

values.name: pitch closeness
values.value: (100 - df0)*3*2 under 100 Hz, + 100 - (ratio - 100) for durations within 2x

values.name: prosodic class table
values.source: LoqTTS7.dll 0x10070f28 (classes per phone not decoded; unused)

values.name: English/French symbol mapping
values.value: t->th k->kh p->ph r->Hr a->Ae (en); t->tt d->dd r->HRF (fr)

values.name: English weak forms and linking
values.value: the → Dh HEh / Dh i; to → th HEh; final t k p d → Hut Huk Hup Hud before a word; Hj / Hw / Hg links

values.name: French liaison and unstressed words
values.value: z after les/des/mes/nous/vous..., t after est/sont/petit..., n after un/mon/on...; little words lose stress (`OE → HEh)
